newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, pressured by sporadic selling, as the market shrugged off the yen's further slip against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.2 yen per kg lower, with the benchmark June dipping 0.1 yen at 145.9 yen.

Sentiment was dampened after the market failed to gain lift from the yen's weakness against the dollar. "Trade in the spot January contract was dominated by position-adjustment ahead of the spot expiry next Monday, while fresh selling by market bears emerged in other months," one trader said.
